$comment: Task board state and stall derivation — the shared oracle for sections 6 and 7 of PLANS/BUZZ_TASK_TRACKER_ARCHITECTURE_2026-09-23.md, consumed by the Rust `buzz tasks board` reducer and by the Desktop TS read model, so the two cannot disagree about one task. Inputs are SEMANTIC, not signed envelopes: a task is its issue's facts plus the public events a maintainer can read. `kind:44200` is deliberately absent — it is owner-scoped by NIP-AM's design, so a seat can decrypt only its own metrics and it is never a board input anywhere (section 6, visibility rule). Every timestamp is unix seconds and every case carries its own `now`, so the file is stable across the year.

constants.failure_notice_prefix: ⚠️ I couldn't process the last request

constants.$watchdog_pubkey: Derived from ~/.config/aitaco/fleet-watchdog.env on hip, 2026-09-23 — not taken on trust.

precedence: Done and Dropped (status 1632) win over everything: a closed task has no board state to derive.

Blocked wins over In Progress. Section 6's table does not order its rows; this file makes the call so two implementations cannot differ. A blocked task with recent activity is still Blocked — it renders under its blocker, and someone chipping at it does not unblock it. Overturn it here, in one place, if that is wrong.
Unassigned wins over Up Next: no assignee is a tracker fault and is pinned to the top of the board.
Otherwise: In Progress when there is activity inside `in_progress_within_secs`, else Up Next.

cases.name: control_reply_in_a_linked_thread_is_activity
cases.spec_case: In Progress = open, activity in a linked thread within 24 h
cases.note: The case every other one is a variation of. If this fails, nothing below means anything.

posts.content: Pushed the branch; CI is running.

cases.name: failure_notice_alone_is_not_activity
cases.spec_case: Activity excludes any post whose content starts with FAILURE_NOTICE_PREFIX
cases.note: The #70 notice says a turn was cut off before it replied. Counting it as activity would let a task look worked-on precisely because nothing was done. The post is recent enough that, if it counted, this would read In Progress — which is what makes the case able to fail.

posts.content: ⚠️ I couldn't process the last request — the turn ran out of tool calls before it replied. Nothing was published, so nobody is working on it. Please re-send if it is still needed.

cases.name: watchdog_nudge_does_not_reset_the_clock_it_measures
cases.spec_case: Activity excludes the watchdog's own posts
cases.note: The stall nudge lands in the task's own thread. If it counted as activity it would reset the very clock that produced it, and TASK_STALLED could fire exactly once per task, ever. Here the last real activity is 5 h old and the nudge is 10 min old: the task must still read stalled.

posts.content: no activity for 4 h: post status, hand back, or mark blocked.

cases.name: reply_in_an_unlinked_thread_is_not_activity
cases.spec_case: Activity counts a kind-9 in any task-thread-LINKED thread
cases.note: Real work, in a thread nobody linked to the task. It does not count, and that is a linking gap rather than a reason to reach for 44200 (section 6). The next case is the same bytes with the link added.

cases.name: the_same_reply_counts_once_the_thread_is_linked
cases.spec_case: buzz issues link --kind thread closes the linking gap
cases.note: Identical to the case above but for one link note. This pair is the argument that the gap 44200 would have filled is closed by linking, not by decryption.

cases.name: an_in_flight_turn_suppresses_the_nudge_but_not_the_state
cases.spec_case: TASK_STALLED suppressed while a turn is in flight on the assignee's seat
cases.note: Surprising and deliberate: an in-flight turn has published nothing yet, so it is not activity and the task still reads Up Next. It suppresses only the nudge, because nagging a seat that is mid-turn is exactly the false alarm section 7 is avoiding. Mac seats have no turn index the watchdog can read, so they get no suppression and `assigneeTurnInFlight` is always false for them.

cases.name: a_seat_that_is_down_is_not_nudged
cases.spec_case: TASK_STALLED requires the assignee's seat to be up
cases.note: A seat that is not running cannot answer a nudge. Its being down is the watchdog's UNIT_DOWN finding, not a task finding.

cases.name: a_nip22_comment_on_the_issue_is_activity
cases.spec_case: Activity counts a NIP-22 comment on the issue
cases.note: The other half of the activity definition. A task can be worked without a linked thread existing at all.

cases.name: activity_older_than_the_issue_does_not_count
cases.spec_case: Activity requires created_at later than the issue's
cases.note: A task extracted from a message in a long-running thread inherits that thread's history. Without the bound, every such task would be born In Progress.

posts.content: Original discussion, before the task existed.

cases.name: an_unassigned_task_is_a_tracker_fault
cases.note: Pinned to the top of the board in red and nudged within 10 minutes. It outranks Up Next even though it is also, literally, next.

cases.name: a_blocked_task_stays_blocked_even_while_it_is_worked
cases.spec_case: Blocked = open with an unresolved blocked-by link
cases.note: See `precedence`: this file makes Blocked outrank In Progress because section 6's table does not order its rows. Recent activity does not unblock a task; only closing its blocker does.
